messages:
Sam (CEO): quick follow-up from the all‑hands — can we capture short bullets on why we won vs why we lost the deals mentioned today? making this thread for rapid notes so leadership + product can act.
Priya (Product): +1. ideally: one-sentence win reason, one-sentence loss reason, and a suggested roadmap ask.
Diego (Sales): selling notes: won a mid-market analytics startup because of dedicated capacity SLA + predictable pricing. lost a regulated fintech because we didn't offer VPC-onboarding timeline they required. also one deal pivoted to a cheaper hosted competitor. :grimacing:
Hannah (Customer Success): CS perspective: onboarding docs for Dedicated are too sparse — customers asked for jumpstart scripts and a checklist for network/firewall config. repeated ask: sample terraform + runbook.
Owen (Eng): technical: for the fintech loss we hit two things: 1) missing private control plane option in their preferred cloud region, 2) long-context model latency sometimes > target for 99th pct. we have a short-term mitigation: automatic routing to a quantized variant with smaller KV cache for customers flagged as "latency-first".
Marta (Data): evals show one of the customers had prompts that hit our worst-case attention pattern (long prefixes with many nested system tokens) — quality dropped 6–8% on BLEU-like metric vs baseline. that's probably why they preferred an in-house tuned model.
Priya (Product): synthesis attempt: win = "predictable performance + onboarding support"; loss = "regulatory/network fit + prompt-sensitive quality regressions". roadmap ask: 1) private deployment MVP in 2 regions, 2) onboarding starter kit (terraform + runbook), 3) routing policy toggle for latency-first customers.
Diego (Sales): add: sales collateral needed — delta doc comparing Dedicated vs hosted, and a short checklist for procurement/security teams (SAML, KMS, audit logs).
Hannah (Customer Success): I'll draft the starter kit + a 30-min onboarding webinar. putting a TODO on CS backlog.
Owen (Eng): I'll prototype a routing-policy flag. quick config example:
```
routing_policies:
  - name: latency_first
    prefer: quantized-variants
    fallback: regional-hosted
    max_latency_ms: 200
```

Owen (Eng): note: kernel availability on some older GPUs means quantized variants may underperform on exact-quality metrics. we should flag per-model quality deltas in Console.
Marta (Data): I can run a short prompt-sensitivity sweep for the top 5 losing customers this quarter and attach per-model deltas.
Sam (CEO): concrete asks from leadership: 1) list of 3 product changes we can ship in <8 weeks; 2) estimated effort and owner for each; 3) any quick win collateral for sales. keep replies here, don't start new threads so we have a single source.
Priya (Product): proposed 3 quick items: (a) onboarding starter kit (owner: Hannah, est 2w), (b) routing-policy flag + Console expose (owner: Owen, est 3w), (c) Dedicated vs Hosted procurement one-pager (owner: Diego, est 1w).
Diego (Sales): I'll own the one-pager and the procurement checklist. will draft by EOD Thursday.
Hannah (Customer Success): starter kit: I'll reuse existing runbooks + add terraform module. target beta with 2 pilot customers in 10 business days.
Owen (Eng): routing flag: will land API + simple Console toggle, then add metrics for per-model quality. core work 3w but can ship API + docs partial in 2w for pilots.
Marta (Data): I'll prioritize prompt-sensitivity reports for pilots; should have first reports in 5 working days.
Sam (CEO): great. final ask — please add any blockers in this thread. also @All-Hands Bot, can you record these action items to the meeting notes? :sparkles:
All-Hands Bot: noted — action items appended to all-hands notes (link: https://redwood.example.co/all-hands/2101112222/notes). :white_check_mark:
Diego (Sales): blocker: legal asked for an example DPA for Dedicated customers — does legal have a template or should we surface a standard one?
Priya (Product): legal template exists but needs red-team review for the Dedicated package. I'll ping Legal.
Owen (Eng): potential blocker: one of our quantized kernels isn't validated on the customer's GPU family — may need a short validation matrix run. I'll schedule infra time.
Hannah (Customer Success): tagging two pilot customers who said they'd help: acme-analytics, moonpay-proto. I'll reach out.
Sam (CEO): perfect. let's reconvene in the next cadence update. thanks everyone — concise and actionable is perfect. :raised_hands:
